academic.summary: Pod lifecycle, ReplicaSet, Deployment rolling update, Service types (ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer), Ingress

market_ready.hands_on_task: Deploy microservices app: 3 services với Deployments, Services, Ingress, HPA. Rolling update without downtime

questions.question: Pod vs Deployment trong Kubernetes?

options.A: Pod: 1+ containers (ephemeral). Deployment: manages ReplicaSet → ensures N pods always running, rolling updates

questions.explanation: Pod: smallest deployable unit, ephemeral. Deployment: desired state declaration. Kubernetes reconcile loop: thực tế ≠ desired → tạo/xóa pods. Rolling update: tăng dần replicas mới, giảm dần replicas cũ.

questions.question: ClusterIP vs NodePort vs LoadBalancer Service?

options.A: ClusterIP: internal only. NodePort: expose trên Node's IP. LoadBalancer: cloud provider external LB

questions.explanation: ClusterIP (default): reachable only inside cluster. NodePort: NodeIP:NodePort, external access. LoadBalancer: cloud LB, production. Ingress: L7 routing (path-based, host-based) → single entry point.

questions.question: Kubernetes liveness vs readiness probe?

options.A: Liveness: container alive? → restart if fail. Readiness: ready to receive traffic? → remove from LB if fail

questions.explanation: Liveness: is container healthy? Fail → kubelet restart pod. Readiness: can serve requests? Fail → remove pod from Service endpoints (không nhận traffic). Startup probe: protect slow-starting containers.

academic.summary: ConfigMap từ file/env, Secret base64 encoding, RBAC (Role/ClusterRole/Binding), Namespace isolation

market_ready.hands_on_task: Setup dev/staging/prod namespaces với RBAC. Secrets từ Vault injected vào pod. ConfigMap cho app config

questions.question: Kubernetes Secrets có thực sự 'secure' không?

options.A: Không hoàn toàn — chỉ base64 encoded (không encrypted by default). Cần encrypt at rest + external vault (HashiCorp Vault/AWS SSM)

questions.explanation: K8s Secrets: base64 chỉ là encoding, không encryption. Ai có kubectl access có thể decode. Production: enable etcd encryption at rest, hoặc dùng Vault Agent Injector, ExternalSecrets Operator, AWS Secrets Manager CSI driver.
